summary: Work submitted to AMLE must be created by the authors rather than AI tools, unless AI use is appropriate to the research question and properly cited. Authors must disclose any AI use in the cover letter and the article acknowledgements, and must confirm they have read AOM's AI policy. The page does not address AI use by reviewers or editors, AI-generated images, or AI authorship.

evidence.quote: must be created by the authors and not the product of artificial intelligence tools unless appropriate to the research question and is properly cited
Authors must be transparent in disclosing any AI use in the manuscript cover letter and in the article acknowledgements.
